They glance toward their own thoughts; the exchange is winding down.
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"About whatever's been weighing on me — I don't want to be alone with my head right now. That's all. That's the whole thing."
"Hey — are you alright?"
"Thanks. ...Thanks for saying that."
"I'm not going anywhere."

"You don't have to say it all at once."
"Help me haul something back? Too much for one."
"All right. Let's go."
You walk to the cache spot with Dmitri. Nothing much there — but they talk the whole way, and you learn the shape of them a little better.
"Wait — what were we talking about?"

"Still on that hard time. That's still where we are."
"Yeah?"
"Well. My social battery is officially dead."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"About the creek water run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Tell me why you need this."
"0 liters. That's today's drinking water, and then we're boiling creek water and hoping. We walk together and each carry two liters back. Creek water still needs boiling."

"Good day, huh? Almost feels normal."
"Come get air with me. I need to think out loud."
"All right. Let's go."
It's quiet at the ridge. Fatima doesn't say much. Sometimes that's the whole point.

"So." They look at the fire for a moment.

A beat. Then, as if shaking something off:
"Take your time."
"Can I trust you? I mean really."
"I hope to earn it."
"That's the right answer. The wrong one would've been 'yes' too fast."
"Take your time."
"I'll tell you what I tell everyone: watch what I do when nobody's watching. That's the whole of me. The rest is just talking."
"Take your time."
"Anyway — I should get back to it. Good talking, though."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."

lines.t: 💛 You hold Contract Quill. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Saplings push up through last year's deadfall, racing each other for the light. The forest never stops trying.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Hungry Road — 2 people, 31 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 6 plants — 4 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — Dehua telling Dmitri about himself. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Mushrooms thumb up through the duff in a ring — a fairy ring, old as the path. You step around it, not through it. Some rules are older than knowledge.

Movement — a box turtle, ancient and unhurried.
👁 Slow. Walk up and pick it up. That's the whole hunt.
Thornfield's clearing. Voices, a cookfire, somebody else's home. You're a guest here — act like it.
💬 Tariq: "Smell that? Something's different here."

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
Something big drank here recently — the mud is churned to soup on the far bank. You drink from the near side, upstream of whatever it was.
👤 A figure steps out of the treeline. Human-shaped. But something's wrong.
They move like someone who's done this before. Many times. On many worlds.
👁 Something about their gear — it hums. Nothing from Earth hums like that.
⚔ STRANGER! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Stranger closes in, patient and unhurried.
✅ You saw the creek. Tariq nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
💬 Tariq: "Stay close, yeah?"
You call a moot on it. The fire gets built up. The petitioners sit just outside the light, trying not to look like they're listening.
Lev stands. "Hungry mouths don't stop being hungry. They just become our hungry mouths."
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.
The fire is built high. Nobody speaks while the count is taken.
Dehua counts on their fingers, twice. Then, to the fire: "1 for taking them in. 7 against."
The moot votes no. Sofia nods like they expected it. "Thanks for the fire, anyway." They walk.
Word later: they walked to The Hungry Road. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Word will travel: Haven is turned away the hungry. Other fires will remember. (Opinion -4 with every village that knows you.)
